decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings and no such other demolition or dismantling shall be carried out

Condition : 4 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands shall be retained to show the historical past of the building in accordance with details which shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, before any work starts on site.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until a method statement outlining the exact details of how the railings and gates to elevations 3 and 4 (as shown on the submitted drawings numbered P01 and P02A received 08/06/2009 and 04/09/2009 respectively) will be fixed to the historic fabric of the building has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until a method statement outlining the exact details of how the key pad and lock will operate, including the location and fixing details of any necessary wiring or other components has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details shown on elevation 2 of drawing P02A received 04/09/2009, detailed drawings showing a revised proposal for security measures to the south facing gate shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
description: Installation of new door entry system to main entrance gate and creation of new entrance with metal railings to front of property to replace the existing. Replacement of timber railings and erection of three gates (Works to a Listed Building)
